subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Mexico's annual Day of the Dead celebration occurs each November.
• It honors deceased family members and loved ones.
• Families create elaborate altars with photos, flowers, and favorite foods of the departed.
• In Mexico City, families gather in Xochimilco's famous floating gardens to build their altars.
• In Oaxaca, families gather in the historic cemetery of San Miguel to build their altars.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize a similarity in how families in Mexico City and Oaxaca observe Day of the Dead. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: In both Mexico City and Oaxaca, families gather to observe Day of the Dead by building altars.
choices.B: The altar-building in Mexico City takes place in floating gardens, whereas the altar-building in Oaxaca takes place in a historic cemetery.
choices.C: Families in both Mexico City and Oaxaca observe Day of the Dead, but they don't do so in exactly the same way.
choices.D: Each November, families in Mexico observe Day of the Dead to honor deceased loved ones.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence emphasizes a similarity in how families in Mexico City and Oaxaca observe Day of the Dead, indicating that families in both cities gather to observe the holiday by building altars.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. The sentence explains when families in Mexico observe Day of the Dead; it doesn't emphasize a similarity in how families in Mexico City and Oaxaca observe the holiday.
